raw_text:
RESEARCH VERDICT  
Verdict: caution  
Risk: high  
Confidence: 0.68  
Rationale: Research weakens the strong-buy case: Q3/9M filing FCF covers the maintained USD 0.10 dividend, but Yahoo FY2025 FCF, 10% sequential aluminium-price weakness and unclosed AliGroup notes keep conviction below the screen.  
RiskTags: cyclical, leverage, regulatory  

COMPARISON EVIDENCE  

EVIDENCE  
- [filings/bodies/45617e6299b6acec.txt] "Generated $643 million in cash from operations; free cash flow was $472 million" — Q3 2026 filing FCF matches the snapshot’s Yahoo quarterly $472m, not the snapshot annual FCF of $567m.  
- [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt] "CASH PROVIDED FROM OPERATIONS" — 9M 2026 operating cash is 1,072 (in millions); less capital expenditures of (476) implies FCF of 596, already above Yahoo FY2025 FCF of 567000000.0 in screening_snapshot.json (Yahoo fallback; no Alcoa 10-K body is in this pack).  
- [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt] "Dividends paid on Alcoa common stock" — 9M 2026 common dividends of (80) versus implied FCF of 596 is well above 1.0× cover; the current snapshot lists no dividend-family passes and no adjusted_signal below strong_buy.  
- [filings/bodies/f0141768272fa670.txt] "USD 0.10000000" — Q3 2026 ordinary quarterly dividend is unchanged (no interim cut); 11/11/2026 update only adds the AUD equivalent.  
- [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt] "Average alumina prices increased 8 percent and average aluminum prices decreased 10 percent in the third quarter of 2026 compared" — sequential aluminium-price drop is already in the 10-Q and sits behind the 8-K sequential Adjusted EBITDA decline.  
- [filings/bodies/45617e6299b6acec.txt] "transaction remains on track to close in the first half of 2027." — AliGroup is still unclosed; South32 shareholder approval is in, regulatory approvals are still described as progressing.  
- [filings/bodies/45617e6299b6acec.txt] "intends to use the proceeds, together with cash on hand, to fund the cash consideration of approximately $3.1 billion for the" — $2.6bn of notes is already on the balance sheet for a cash outflow that has not yet occurred.  
- [filings/bodies/7e4f77e209cdf732.txt] "implied enterprise value of up to US$5.6B (the Transaction).  Alcoa will also assume related rehabilitation provisions" — deal scale includes cash, stock, assumed net debt/leases and rehabilitation, plus up to US$750m contingent consideration stated in the same South32 announcement.  

NUMBERS  
- Free cash flow | $472 million | quarter ended 30 September 2026 | [filings/bodies/45617e6299b6acec.txt]  
- Cash provided from operations | 1,072 | nine months ended 30 September 2026 | [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt]  
- Capital expenditures | (476) | nine months ended 30 September 2026 | [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt]  
- Dividends paid on Alcoa common stock | (80) | nine months ended 30 September 2026 | [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt]  
- Long-term debt, less amount due within one year | 4,821 | 30 September 2026 | [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt]  
- Total dividend/distribution payment amount per +security | USD 0.10000000 | quarter ended 30/9/2026 | [filings/bodies/f0141768272fa670.txt]  

THESIS BREAKS  
- AliGroup fails to close after the September 2026 notes, leaving $2.6bn of 6.625%/6.875% debt without the acquired cash flows.  
- Aluminium/alumina prices reverse enough that quarterly FCF turns negative, as in Q3 2025 ($(66) million in the 8-K table), and the USD 0.10 dividend is cut.  
- A competition, foreign-investment or mining-permit condition blocks Worsley/Boddington or the Transaction on terms that strand the pre-funded cash.  
- Post-close, the up to US$750m contingent cash plus assumed rehabilitation of approximately US$1.2B crystallises into a downturn that lifts leverage beyond covenant or refinancing capacity.
